_note: Created for the MicroFlame site: environments.json was not part of the FireGap archive. Gravity values were read from the NASA NSSDCA Planetary Fact Sheets on the retrieval date below.
source: NASA NSSDCA Planetary Fact Sheets (Goddard Space Flight Center)

environments.label: Earth
environments.basis: Standard acceleration of gravity, CODATA 2018 (exact), as quoted on the NASA Earth Fact Sheet
environments.psi_note: All PSI tests in this dataset ran in microgravity; Earth is shown as the 1 g reference.

environments.label: Moon
environments.psi_note: No PSI test in this dataset was run at lunar gravity.

environments.label: Mars
environments.basis: Surface gravity, mean (Mars Fact Sheet); equatorial surface acceleration is 3.69
environments.psi_note: No PSI test in this dataset was run at Martian gravity.

environments.label: Open space (orbit)
environments.basis: Orbital free fall (microgravity). Residual micro-g accelerations on the ISS are measured by SAMS/MAMS (fact G19); the dataset gives no number, so 0 is used.
environments.psi_note: BASS, BASS-II, FLEX and ACME ran on the ISS; Saffire I-III in the free-flying Cygnus.
